nom: Dr.Reju-All Advanced PDRN Copper Peptide Serum 1.01 Fl Oz

segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including one managing a compromised skin barrier, report no irritation and good tolerance even when layering with other actives; one reviewer with sensitive skin had a severe reaction, describing an itchy, blistering rash across her whole face.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one prone to visible dehydration lines and one with slightly dry skin whose 'orange peel' texture improved, report the serum hydrates well and smooths the skin, with a few noting brief tackiness right after application.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing aging, post-menopausal or 40s-plus skin report the serum mainly helps through better hydration and skin barrier support, which makes fine lines look softer, rather than through dramatic firming or wrinkle reduction.

concerns.aging: Reviewers are divided on how much this serum affects visible aging: several describe plumper, smoother-looking skin and softer fine lines, largely attributing this to better hydration and barrier function rather than dramatic firming; one detailed critical review says she saw no meaningful change in wrinkles, firmness or elasticity, and another questions whether the PDRN and copper peptide concentrations are high enough to do what the label implies.
concerns.dehydration: This is the benefit reported most consistently and by far the most reviewers: nearly everyone describes noticeably plumper, smoother, better-hydrated skin, in one case specifically erasing visible dehydration lines on dry skin.
concerns.redness: The only detailed report of redness or reaction is a severe one: one reviewer with sensitive skin developed an itchy, blistering rash across a previously clear face; no other reviewer describes redness.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers, including one with sensitive or compromised skin, credit the serum's niacinamide, panthenol, beta-glucan, allantoin and adenosine with supporting and restoring the skin barrier, reporting skin that feels more balanced and functions better after a few weeks.
concerns.spots: The one reviewer who addresses this reports her acne scars looking better and her skin feeling soothed after nine days of use; no other reviewer comments on spots or scarring specifically.

Distinctive blue copper-peptide fleck disappears on application
Premium-feeling packaging with clear usage instructions

extraits.texte: it's meh. It's the usual with these products. PDRN 1,200 parts per million. Translation= very little PDRN. Copper Peptides 1% = nothing. Hyaluronic Acid 0.02%. So what's left is you're paying for a lot of synthetics: glycerin, solvents, alcohol. Yes they leave your skin looking glassy, they moisturize a bit, but they don't really contain enough actives to do what is says it will do.

extraits.texte: Had such a bad reaction! I got a blistering itchy rash all over my face. Be careful if you have sensitive skin! Mine skin was perfectly clear and now it’s basically one giant blister and looks like I have horrific acne but it’s blisters.

extraits.titre: The orange peel look is going away
extraits.texte: I love this serum. I'm mid-50's with slightly dry, sensitive skin. My face has become smoother since using this, and I had a small area on my cheek that looked like "orange peel skin". This is helping it go away. The only thing is it's a little tacky for 15 minutes, and then that tacky feeling goes away. I just put up with it for awhile, although I hate sticky skincare. No scent.

I have a few preferred K-beauty brands and Dr. Reju-All has quickly become one of them! This Advanced PDRN Copper Peptide Serum has been absolutely fantastic so far. I haven’t seen a serum that mixes these particular ingredients together and was super excited to try this—and it has exceeded my expectations already with barely a week of use of it! The Good: -this has a good mix of peptides, PDRN, niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, adenosine, and some oils. No ingredients seemed to stand out in the list that raised any concerns. -this is made in Korea by a really excellent brand. -packaging has clear instructions, lists ingredients, and is simple but effective. -this layers incredibly well with other products. When used with other Dr. Reju-All items, it seamlessly blends into the routine and provides a great boost of moisture, plumpness to skin, and makes my face feel like it is retaining that moisture for longer. It also works well with products from other brands, too. My dry skin loves this. I can see a visible difference when I use and I can feel it, too. Skin just feels better with this in my routine somehow. After <1 week of use, I might be imagining it, but I think my skin looks better overall. I don’t have much in the way of wrinkles but I can get dehydration lines because my skin is dry. This erases them and they seem to stay away longer and longer each time. For an even better experience, this works brilliantly with the Dr. Reju-All Advanced PDRN Rejuvenating Cream applied

extraits.titre: My Skin Definitely Looks Better Using It
extraits.texte: At 52 with very dry, post-menopausal skin, I’ve learned to be realistic about skincare. No serum is going to erase decades of aging, lift sagging skin, or magically make wrinkles disappear. What good products can do is improve hydration, support the skin barrier, give skin a healthier appearance, and make lines look softer because the skin is functioning better. That’s where this serum fits for me. The first thing that caught my attention was the manufacturer. This is made by Cosmax, one of Korea’s largest and most respected cosmetic manufacturers, and I’ve had consistently good experiences with products coming out of their facilities. The formula is built around several ingredients that I actively look for. It contains PDRN (Sodium DNA), copper peptides, multiple additional peptides, niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, hydrolyzed collagen, panthenol, beta-glucan, allantoin, adenosine, and sodium PCA. Instead of relying on one trendy ingredient, it combines several categories that focus on hydration, skin support, and overall skin quality. Texture is excellent. The serum feels lightweight going on, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave behind a sticky or heavy film. The blue color comes from the copper peptide content, but it disappears completely once applied. It layers well under moisturizer and sunscreen and has not pilled with any of the products in my routine. What I’ve noticed most is improved hydration and a healthier-looking glow. extraits.titre: Great copper peptide pdrn serum for sensitive skin
extraits.texte: This copper peptide PDRN serum works exceptionally well on sensitive skin. Unlike other copper peptide brands that can be sticky and difficult to layer, this formula is non-sticky, spreads evenly, and feels deeply hydrating. The combination of PDRN and copper peptides in a single serum is ideal for anyone dealing with sensitive skin or a compromised skin barrier, as both components function as skin-rejuvenating and anti-aging ingredients. One unique characteristic is that the serum dries down to a powdery finish, leaving a thin layer of residue that feels like powder on both the face and fingers once fully dry. However, the formulation is entirely fragrance-free and causes no negative side effects. After a couple of weeks of consistent use, the skin feels balanced and hydrated. While major improvements such as visible skin tightening or wrinkle reduction are not yet apparent, continued long-term use will be required to evaluate full results.
